title: Rights and levels
lead: See what you may do in HiveVoice, why, and what you need for the next level.
leadShort: What you may do and why.

levels.name: Guest
levels.text: You can read. Sign in to take part.

levels.name: Account
levels.text: You can react, send requests, join groups and attach files. You may write in groups with open entry after the first day.

levels.name: Verified
levels.text: You may write everywhere, found groups, start initiatives, vote, register responsibilities and share.

levels.name: Official
levels.text: You speak for an office. Your role is confirmed by an official email.

levels.name: Moderation
levels.text: You look after running the platform, such as bans and settings. This is logged.

modes.login: In the test phase a login counts as verified.
modes.vouch: You are verified when two verified people vouch for you and your account is a day old.
modes.eid: You are verified with the online ID.

vouchNone: Nobody vouches for you yet. Ask people who know you to vouch on your profile.
ageWait: Your account is {hours} hours old. After 24 hours the vouches count.
vouchGiven: In the last 30 days you gave {n} of 5 possible vouches.
sanctionOpen: Your account is paused ({kind}) until it is lifted.
